g.title: erd
g.text: Solid lines: rows refer to another table's key. Dashed: rows name a role (kernel, nic, hop:1:2, target:1, …), which has no table of its own.
PK: primary key. Times are µs since the Unix epoch (UTC). Retention under each table name.
